Strategy: Test the item-scaled wide band here, rewarding half an item for leftovers between twenty-five and fifty with no penalty. It may help if item-scaled rewards generalize across seeds, but may fail if the wide window dilutes the effect.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item / 2 if r - item >= 25 and r - item <= 50 else 0) for r in bins]
```
